h1: Cinematic Product Video From One Still Photo
lead: Pick a moody reveal and add one photo, so the product gets a slow camera move, a voice, and a music bed without a film crew.

steps.d: Use a sharp photo with the full silhouette in frame. A clear edge gives the move something to follow.
Name the surface, one light, and one slow move. Then pick one size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Add a voice, captions, and a music bed, then download. A logo on the photo stays. No new logo is added.

faq.q: What is a cinematic product video template?
faq.a: A ready scene that gives one product photo a controlled light and a slow reveal. You bring the still, and you can add a voice, captions, and a music bed so the clip opens like a short brand film.

faq.q: How do I make the film?
faq.a: Upload a sharp photo or paste a product link, name the surface, one light, and one camera move, pick a size and a length, then add sound in the editor and download.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a film crew?
faq.a: The set, the light, and the move are generated from the photo you already have. You skip the crew, the rental, and the reshoot.
Shops with a clear product shape or finish, such as speakers, bottles, lamps, watches, and sunglasses, that want a polished open for a page or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Start with a sharp full-silhouette photo and name one move, such as a slow push-in or a short side glide. Check the edge before you post.
A sharp photo with the full product in frame, clear edges, and enough contrast against the background. A public product link works when that page already shows the still.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Pick one of 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 for each job. Make 16:9 for a page and 9:16 for a feed as two files from the same photo. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Does the clip include a voice, music, or my logo?
faq.a: You can add an AI voice, captions, and a track from the music library in the built-in editor. A logo already printed on the product photo stays part of that photo. The clip does not add a new logo.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run on your site and in paid ads. You can also send it to TikTok or Meta from the workspace. Review reflective frames for glare before you post. The clip is your ad, not a customer quote.

faq.q: Can I batch products or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same light across a set of stills, switch the spoken line to another language, or send photos through the API. Each job shows its credit cost first.
